scope: Owned snapshot capture plus volatile callbacks isolate compiler behavior. Input ownership is transferred, without cloning inside the measured window; immutable snapshot validation and token estimates are included in cold, reused in warm. Artifact metadata and leases are refreshed every pass; no durability claim for those samples. Separate P05 rows include WAL FULL, blob/directory sync, original journal/request custody, integrity-checked reopen and page rehydration. Kernel caches are not evicted. Allocation values are allocator requests, not RSS. Logical file bytes are retained sizes, not physical device writes.
